contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' on the p4 Summary Page, an oval ZERO, equal to Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received', both also oval zeros written in the filer's blue ink (p2)
contributions.detail: ZERO rows against a printed zero, three times stated. Report 1's Schedule A (p2) carries NO entries and the filer wrote an oval 0 at both printed footers; Box B repeats it. Under the zero-glyph ruling an oval zero is a NUMERAL, so the honest reconciliation is zero rows summing to 0 against a printed 0. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 19,500 - the cycle figure carried from this filer's own earlier (pre-Primary) report bound at pp5-9 of the same PDF - and is NEVER summed as an increment and NEVER used to import that report's rows here. ⚠⚠ THE §K4 GHOST SCREEN IS WHAT MADE THIS CALL: at 200 dpi p2's grid LOOKS like fourteen filled rows. It is not. A 900 dpi crop of the whole amount column (pct:72.89,22.71,10.71,14.0@p2) renders those marks as PALE GREY SHOW-THROUGH with no ink relief, while the same crop of the footers renders the filer's zeros in unmistakable BLUE ballpoint. The ghost text is legible enough to identify: it reads 'Yard signs for Convention', 'Repayment of Loan', 'Olive Garden / Dinner for Volunteers' - i.e. it is the EXPENDITURE ledger on the very next sheet (p3) bleeding through the paper under the photographer's light. Every one of those phrases appears on p3. So the page is genuinely blank and this is `empty-schedule`, not a missed transcription; publishing those ghosts would have invented fourteen contributions out of the filer's own expenditure list.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' on the p4 Summary Page - printed '9854.66' STRUCK THROUGH with '9957.52' written beside it - equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Expenditures Made', each likewise struck from 9854.66 and corrected to 9,957.52 (p3)
expenditures.detail: 14 Schedule B rows sum to 57.72 + 4.00 + 445.09 + 184.58 + 115.28 + 122.99 + 299.43 + 200.00 + 7500.00 + 425.00 + 500.00 + 24.00 + 49.43 + 30.00 = 9,957.52 EXACTLY = the CORRECTED page subtotal = the CORRECTED grand total = the CORRECTED Box D. The handwritten correction over the struck typed-in value GOVERNS (CHUNK_BRIEF §7), and here it is independently confirmed by the summary ladder: F = A + B = 11,586.36 + 0 = 11,586.36 and the printed close box is 1,628.84, which is 11,586.36 - 9,957.52 to the cent - i.e. the close box was computed from the CORRECTED figure, not the struck one. The superseded 9,854.66 was retained verbatim in this note and published nowhere. Box E YTD prints 17,468.50 and is never summed as an increment; note for the record, adjudicating nothing, that it does not equal this report's 9,957.52 plus the other bundled report's 7,913.64 (17,871.16) - a filer inconsistency in the cumulative column that touches no itemized row.

itemized.notes: ⚠⚠ REPORT 1 OF 2 IN A GENUINE MULTI-REPORT BUNDLE - one of only two in the whole corpus. report_index=1. HOW THE BUNDLE WAS SPLIT, from the PAGES' OWN printed dates and headings and never by assuming an ordinal: PDF pp1-4 are REPORT 1 and pp5-9 are REPORT 2. The evidence is threefold and each part is on the page. (a) REPORT TYPE: p1's cover ticks '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination'; p5's cover ticks 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election'. (b) DATE OF REPORT: pp1-4 carry 5/7/24 (and 5/6/24 on the Schedule B sheet); pp5-9 carry 4/11/24 throughout. So the 30-days-after-withdrawal report is bound FIRST even though it POSTDATES the pre-Primary report it follows - exactly the inversion the chunk brief warns of. (c) THE FILER'S OWN FOLIATION RESTARTS: p1 'Page 1', p2 'Page 2', p3 (Page box left blank), p4 'Page 4'; then p5 'Page 1', p6 'Page 2', p7 'Page 3', p8 'Page 4', p9 'Page 5'. A four-sheet report followed by a five-sheet report = 9 pages, with nothing missing and nothing shared. Corroboration from the balances, used as a CHECK and never as the basis: report 2's close box (11,586.36) is report 1's Box A, the ordinary hand-off from the earlier period to the later one. THE TWO REPORTS WERE RECONCILED SEPARATELY, each against ITS OWN summary page - report 1 against the p4 Summary, report 2 against the p9 Summary - and NO ROW, NO SUBTOTAL AND NO BOX WAS EVER SHARED, MERGED OR DIFFERENCED ACROSS THEM. THIS REPORT: page-face candidate 'Tom Westmoreland' (signature block prints 'Tom W. Westmoreland'); Office box reads 'County Commissioner' with NO SEAT LETTER, so no seat is inferred here even though index.csv's channel label says 'County Commission Seat C' - the page does not print it (§5, and the do-not-infer-a-seat rule). Report type '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination'. ⚠ THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNANSWERED on this cover - neither 'No' nor 'Yes' is marked - which is an honest BLANK and is never read as 'No' (§A4); note report 2's cover in the same PDF DOES tick 'No', so the two differ. Signature date 5/7/24, Date of Report 5/7/24. FORM: modern_boxAF, footer 'v. 12.23' on all four sheets, masthead 'Aaron Davidson / Clerk', four-column Schedule A, Schedule B with a real Purpose column, Summary located BY CONTENT on p4 with an UNLETTERED close box. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound anywhere in the 9-page bundle. ⚠ NEW SOURCE PROPERTY - THE WHOLE FILING IS A SET OF PHONE PHOTOGRAPHS, not a scan: each sheet lies on a dark desk with the surrounding surface visible, lit unevenly (a lamp flare sits in the top-right of pp1 and 3), and the resulting PERSPECTIVE makes the row pitch grow measurably down every page. Two consequences worth recording as precedent: rowbands returns FEWER rules than there are rows on the more oblique sheets (14 of 16 on p7 and p8), so the last bands must be extrapolated at the GROWING pitch and crop-proved individually; and the photographic lighting is what produces the §K4 show-through that made p2 look filled. Sheets 5-9 are photographs of a PHOTOCOPY (a second generation), noticeably smaller in frame and greyer. REDACTION is the county's and covers the cover's Address block and Signature; the phone number and email are left in the clear on p1 and are NOT carried into this record (privacy applied at read time). Both sides of report 1 close EXACTLY - the contribution side on a printed zero, the expenditure side on the filer's own handwritten correction, which the summary's close box independently confirms.

expenditures.detail: TRACED, LOCALISED, AND NOTHING NUDGED. The 30 Schedule B rows sum to 7,914.14, which is +0.50 over Box D. The PER-SHEET gate (§L2 - and both sheets do print their own subtotal, so each is a closable unit) localises it precisely: SHEET p8's 15 rows sum to 117.87 + 10.30 + 92.31 + 5.00 + 415.51 + 4.00 + 115.28 + 113.40 + 12.33 + 39.70 + 61.98 + 500.00 + 300.00 + 300.00 + 500.00 = 2,587.68, EXACTLY its printed subtotal; SHEET p7's 15 rows sum to 49.19 + 767.11 + 20.33 + 500.00 + 70.00 + 925.00 + 1246.22 + 117.87 + 750.61 + 47.92 + 152.81 + 225.00 + 70.00 + 84.40 + 300.00 = 5,326.46 against its own printed subtotal of 5,325.96. So the entire delta is +0.50 on ONE sheet, p7, and the whole of it is the filer's arithmetic: his two printed page subtotals add to his printed grand total and to Box D to the cent, so the figure he under-added is the p7 page subtotal itself. WHAT WAS RULED OUT BEFORE CALLING IT FILER ARITHMETIC: (a) MISREAD CELL - ALL FIFTEEN p7 amount cells were escalated to 1200 dpi and every one reproduced exactly as recorded; the only cell whose cents were even arguable, row 12's 225.00, was re-escalated to 1600 dpi and its raised 'co' cents match the same filer's 500.co / 925.co / 70.00 elsewhere on the sheet, so no single cell can absorb 0.50 and the attribution is NOT unique (the §C5 outcome: 'more than one cell could have explained it, so I changed none'). (b) §H3 DOUBLED BAND and (c) §F1 trap-5 A ROW BELOW THE LAST RULE - both EXCLUDED BY DIRECTION as well as by crop: a missed row makes a sum fall SHORT, and this sum runs OVER; the row-15 crop rendered the last entry and the strip below it rendered the printed subtotal label. (d) §H4 an in-grid subtotal - excluded, rows 1-14 total 5,026.46, not 300.00. (e) CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN - run INSIDE the document, which is the only place it can honestly be run here: the same filer's OTHER report in this same bundle closes EXACTLY on its expenditure side (after his own correction), so the +0.50 is a one-off slip and not a repeating habit; his 2026 filing exists in index.csv but was NOT opened, because differencing across filings is forbidden. The printed subtotal is retained verbatim at 5,325.96, all 30 rows publish verbatim, and every p7 row carries needs_review=1 since the delta cannot be pinned to one of them.
